input.number-negative: Enter the number without a minus sign.

action.amount-and-units: {coin}: enter both the amount and the units.
action.unknown-coin: {coin} is not in your plan. Add it in Settings first.
action.fee-negative: Enter a fee of zero or more.
action.fee-not-allowed: Leave the fee empty for coins added; include any fee you paid in the cost.
action.slot-required: Choose the month this buy is for.
action.slot-not-allowed: Only a monthly buy has a month.
action.unknown-slot: {slot} is not a month of your plan.
action.sell-exceeds-held: This sale is {excess} more than you hold ({held} on {date}). Check the amount and the date, or log the missing purchases first.
action.slot-done: {slot} is already recorded. Edit or delete that entry in the Log.
action.slot-skipped: {slot} is already skipped. Log this purchase as an extra buy.
action.note-too-long: Use at most {max} characters in the note.
action.venue-too-long: Use at most {max} characters in the venue.
action.pause-order: Choose an end on or after the start.
action.pauses-overlap: This pause overlaps another one. Choose other dates.
action.before-first-buy: The plan has not started yet, so there is no buying to end.
action.plan-changed: Your plan changed in another browser tab, so this purchase was not recorded. Check the amounts shown, then record it again.
action.too-many-entries: Recording this would take the plan past {max} entries, the most a plan holds. Delete entries in the Log to make room.

backup.not-recognised: This file is not in a format {product} can read. Export a backup from {product}, then import that file.
backup.not-recognised-pasted: This text is not in a format {product} can read. Copy the whole export again, then paste it.
backup.prototype-invalid: The plan in this file from the DCA plan page is not complete, so nothing was imported. Check its amounts and dates there, export it again, then import the new file.
backup.newer-version: This backup comes from a newer version of {product}. Update the app, then import it again.
backup.invalid-backup: This backup is damaged and cannot be imported. Export a new one.
backup.not-prototype: This file is not a backup from the DCA plan page.
backup.invalid-plan: The plan in this file is not complete. Check the dates and amounts, then import it again.

unknown: This could not be completed. Try again; if it happens again, export a copy of your data.
